about: A global monster_art that blanks the carrying ogre's walk: the swap is real for any class, and after the fixture's load (the reload path) the carrying ogres still have the game's walk as sprite_index, so mask and animation match the live path.

steps.name: gnx_scn_patrol_walk
steps.why: the walk is swapped to none for a Peasant captive

steps.name: gnx_scn_carry_ogres
steps.why: the fixture has ogres carrying captives

steps.name: gnx_scn_carry_ogres
steps.why: every carrying ogre keeps the game's walk as its sprite_index after the load

steps.name: gnx_scn_carry_ogres
steps.why: and still has a mask (scr_ogre_spd_b slows monsters it overlaps)

steps.name: gnx_scn_carry_ogres
steps.why: after a save and reload: ogres still carry
